name: TapTap Console
description: Uses the locally installed Console CLI to discover and execute Console agent workflows. The plugin does not call the API directly, store tokens, or bundle the CLI binary.
whenToUse: Use for Console resources through the local CLI. Check the CLI and production login first; start browser authorization only when the user explicitly asks to log in.

console_cli_status.description: Check whether the local Console CLI is installed, its version, and production login state. Returns only safe account and permission summaries, never tokens; gives the official manual install hint when missing.

console_cli_login.description: Only when the user explicitly asks to log in, run console-cli auth login so the CLI opens the browser for OAuth and stores its own session. An optional permission level or profile may be supplied, but not both.

console_cli_discover.description: Read the Console CLI agent-discovery overview or skill list. Read-only; it does not execute Console operations.

console_cli_help.description: Read root help or help for a lower-case dotted CLI command. Arbitrary flags and shell commands are not accepted.

console_cli_schema.description: Use console-cli schema to retrieve structured parameters, request body, response, and constraints for a manifest-backed command.

console_cli_call.description: Execute a manifest-backed command through the local console-cli in the fixed production context. Shell, arbitrary argv, endpoints, and tokens are rejected; mutation failures distinguish not_executed from unknown.
